notes: Applied in order to every prompt before it reaches M365 Copilot; rules with reverse=true are mapped back in replies.
find/replace: text, or a .NET regular expression when regex=true ($1 etc. refer to groups). reverse is not allowed with regex.
wholeWord (default true, plain text only): word-character ends must sit on word boundaries, so 'cline' does not touch 'decline'.
Copy to ~/.browser-coding-agent/replacements.json (or set Chat:ReplacementsFile) to customize; restart the server to reload.
Defaults target Cline's system prompt: 'You are Cline, an AI coding agent.' and its <user_input mode=...>, <mode_notice>, <env> wrappers.
Tool aliases: Cline's tool names (sdk DefaultToolNames + switch_to_act_mode) are renamed in prompts, so Copilot does not map them onto its own tools; tool calls and text are mapped back.

Tool vocabulary (tool call / tool_call / toolcall / tool / tools) becomes the made-up word 'vexlo', so Copilot does not connect these instructions to its own built-in tools; longer phrases are listed first.
appendToPrompt: added to the end of every prompt after the replacements run, so its own words (e.g. 'tools') are not renamed; write aliased words (vexlo ping) literally. Empty string disables it.

Persona and environment rules run first: 'You are Cline, ...' becomes a task description, and 'Environment you are running in:' becomes 'The user's computer:' so Copilot does not treat Cline's paths as its own sandbox.
appendToPrompt: Reply with text only. Do not run code, do not use your code interpreter, sandbox, or any built-in tools, do not browse the web, and do not create images or files. File paths in this conversation are on the user's computer. When you need a file's contents, a search, or a command's output, do not say you cannot access it: write a vexlo ping block and the application sends you the result.
